description: Rearrange a track's elements (defaults to the video/clip track) into the given order and recompute sequential startTimes so they play back-to-back. Pass element ids in the desired order; omitted elements keep their relative order and are appended after. Ids come from get_project. Blocked in read-only mode.

gap.description: Seconds of gap to insert between elements. Default 0.

order.description: Element ids in the desired playback order.

trackId.description: Track to reorder. Defaults to the video track.

name: reorder_timeline
title: Reorder timeline elements
